title: The Devil You Become
overview: Amidst a super virus that ravages most of the world’s population, a tenacious microbiology student leads a small team through a rogue planned exposure. But the human trials end tragically, taking his friends’ lives one by one and leaving potential treatments untested. As he becomes more and more isolated, the line between what’s real and what’s not begins to blur.
